projects.title: Independent Study in Short-Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public product-review text records using Python and pandas during a supervised undergraduate independent study on short-document classification.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn and compared classification errors across document lengths within the supervised project.

research.title: Research Assistance in Short-Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public discussion-topic text records using Python and pandas as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier with scikit-learn and compared classification errors across document lengths as part of the supervised research.
